uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-3899.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-3899.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

215-1129-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-7730.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

145-687-1669-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-687-1669-6099.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Serra's Sanctum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Serra's Sanctum enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
145-687-1669-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2034-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-2452-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1651-3129-7318.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

5470-6188-7296.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
5470-6188-7296.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two tapped lands on the battlefield.
997-6972-7232.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7157.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2557-3690-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-3690-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Sylvan Awakening
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1168-1479-5414.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1168-1479-5414.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-1492-1537.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-1537.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Zealous Conscripts.
When Zealous Conscripts enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-554-997.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-997.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1808-4321-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4214-5189-6584.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4214-5189-6584.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Zodiark's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4365-5658-6245-6441.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4365-5658-6245-6441.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
4365-5658-6245-6441.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

224-872-1174.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
224-872-1174.notablePrerequisites: Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
224-872-1174.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

913-3525-4893-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
913-3525-4893-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

618-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hazel's Brewmaster with haste.
When the Hazel's Brewmaster token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

1069-1232-5223-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5223-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

864-2639-2921-3254-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-2639-2921-3254-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-2639-2921-3254-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1624-2928-3625-3646.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-2928-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
1624-2928-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2438-3817-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
2438-3817-5170.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 2.
Repeat.

3750-4689-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least four experience counters.
3750-4689-5231.description:
Declare Otharri as an attacker.
Otharri triggers, causing you to get an experience counter and create at least five 2/2 Rebel creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod five times by sacrificing five Rebels, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2341-2751-3649.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2341-2751-3649.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator and The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {3} and tapping them, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

224-322-2167-3177.notablePrerequisites:
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Forest.
224-322-2167-3177.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a basic Forest, adding {G}.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, causing you to put the basic Forest from your graveyard into your hand.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the basic Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
The Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

889-1018-4050-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}.
Deekah triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Skullwinder.
Skullwinder enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand and causing target opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fractal, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1162-5253.notablePrerequisites: Brion does not have summoning sickness.Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1162-5253.description:
Activate Brion by paying {R}, tapping it and sacrificing Angelic Enforcer, dealing damage equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total and causing you to gain that much life.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

3007-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3007-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3007-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Toymaker.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
